name: Version compare
summary: Compare version numbers, check minimum version
author: friday-core
description: Compares version numbers (semver, four-part FRIDAY versions such as 1.1.5.7, Python and Node versions), says which is newer and where they first differ, sorts a list from oldest to newest and checks each against a minimum. Parts are compared as numbers (1.10 is newer than 1.9), missing parts count as 0 and a pre-release (-rc.1) is older than its release.
